answer: Fake identities stall on a wander route: in 30 days an agent must finish jobs for 5 different clients, each stop sealed in umber by the client in a route log. A bid above ten units needs five umber seals plus a nectar draw, the payout drawn from the pool only once the route is complete. Two peers retrace it with clients within two days; a forged seal or an early nectar draw burns a 24-unit bond, so 100 fakes need 500 stops, risking 2,400 units.
